report.headline: Five new construction sites in the areas you serve, west and southwest Houston.
report.supportingCopy: Picked for your 15- and 20-yard roll-offs and the areas on your site: Katy, Sugar Land, Rosenberg, Cypress and Tomball. Each site comes from a TCEQ construction stormwater record.

projects.name: Fifth Third Bank Shops at Katy
projects.whatsFiled: Construction stormwater authorization for a commercial site, operator on file The Fifth Third Bank. The record lists no project value or finish date.
projects.likelyScope: Roll-off containers for construction and packaging debris on a bank branch and retail build; our read from the site type.
projects.whoDecides: Operator on file is The Fifth Third Bank, the owner, a routing contact for which contractor runs the site. No hauler is named in the record, which is not the same as no hauler chosen.
projects.contactLine: Operator on file: The Fifth Third Bank (business name from the TCEQ record)
projects.firstStep: Call the operator's main office and ask who books site services for this job.

projects.whoDecides: Operator on file is Dallas Commercial Builders LLC, a routing contact, not confirmed as the hauling decision-maker. No hauler is named in the record, which is not the same as no hauler chosen.
projects.contactLine: Operator on file: Dallas Commercial Builders LLC (from the TCEQ record)

pilot.headline: How this list was built.
bullets: Five sites pulled from TCEQ construction stormwater records, each with its own authorization number.
Distances and hauling scope are our read of the public record, not confirmation that work has started or that a hauler is unselected.
No individual names; every contact is a business name on file.
pilot.disclosure: A stormwater authorization shows a site is permitted for construction; it does not say who hauls for it.
